id: title:jabahamondes:explain what the retention numbers mean

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies retention rate definitions and cohort attribution for Marketing Analytics users, and explains summary calculation behavior to prevent misinterpretation of aggregated retention rates.
review.reason: Adds explanatory tooltips and an info icon to RetentionCohortTable and RetentionSummaryTable components, clarifying retention rate definitions and summary calculation behavior.
review.uncertainty: This chunk is frontend-only; no backend, query, or warehouse implementation is supplied, so tier and benefit cannot be established.
